answer: The Epoch Consistency Toll requires each identity to sign a cross-epoch record of actions and declared capacities; an atlas of prior commitments is checked against the current epoch. If drift exceeds a fixed threshold, the identity must pay a revalidation fee and its payout bridge is paused until the record matches. Each Sybil clone therefore pays the full fee, loses accrued epoch rewards, and must build a fresh shale layer of history before earning.
